thread:
Leah Park: FYI we got a last-minute slot at Ridgewood DevNight on Jun 2. It's smaller than the summit but good fit for dev-first demos + a 20-min micro-workshop. Need quick ops: workshop slide owner, swag split, booth shifts, and lead capture. who can pick up roles?
Marco Diaz: I can run the micro-workshop. will draft a 15-slide deck and a 3-step hands-on tutorial (20 mins). need a laptop + HDMI.
Nina Zhao: i'll own swag & shipping. pref order: 250 stickers, 120 tees, 40 travel mugs. vendor quote from BadgeCraft looks best — 7 business day lead.
Omar Khan: i'll do onsite AV + table layout. can bring spare HDMI dongles. also request one power strip and a long ethernet cable.
Leah Park: perfect. Nina, can you drop final counts by Tue so we can confirm vendor?
Nina Zhao: yes. provisional counts above. can we reduce tees to 100 if budget tight?
Evelyn Wu: i'll handle lead capture + inbound routing. plan: single-page HubSpot form + QR code on table. routing: leads tagged workshop -> growth@redwood.com, demo -> demos@redwood.com. will add UTM params for source tracking.
Marco Diaz: workshop plan: quick intro (5m), hands-on (12m), q&a (3m). will include a short eval form at the end (emoji thumbs).
Leah Park: booth banner copy ideas (short): A) "Inference for production teams." B) "LLM serving that just works." React :one: for A, :two: for B.
Marco Diaz: :two:
Nina Zhao: :one:
Omar Khan: :two:
Leah Park: designer will mock both. also need a 1-sheet handout summarizing deployment modes: Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Nina + Marco: who can draft content?
Marco Diaz: i'll draft tech blurb for the 1-sheet. keep it one paragraph per mode.
Nina Zhao: i'll handle the visual layout with design after Marco drops copy.
Evelyn Wu: HubSpot form fields: name, email, company, interest (workshop/demo/enterprise), notes. plan form redirect to /thanks with UTM capture. I'll test webhook to /integrations/hubspot.
Leah Park: shipping label for Nina:
```
Redwood Inference — Ridgewood DevNight
c/o Events Desk
Hall B, Ridgewood Conference Center
210 Market St, Ridgewood, NJ 07001
Contact: Nina Zhao +1-555-0199
```
Nina Zhao: noted. ETA requirements: BadgeCraft needs approval by May 24. will confirm by end of week.
Omar Khan: volunteers needed for shifts: 9:30-12, 12-2:30, 2:30-5. Anyone available?
Leah Park: I'm 9:30-12, Marco can do 12-2:30 after workshop, Evelyn can cover 2:30-5. still need one extra for midday.
Nina Zhao: i'll cover midday and handle restocking.
Marco Diaz: workshop slide deadline May 28. I'll post a draft link here when ready.
Evelyn Wu: QA checklist for lead routing: test form submit, webhook fires, leads show in HubSpot with correct tags. I'll run test on Wed.
marketing-bot: created calendar event "Ridgewood DevNight 1 Jun 2: Booth + Workshop" and invited participants.
Leah Park: last item: swag prize drawing rules. idea: collect business cards or form entries and draw one travel mug + one tee at 4:45. agree?
Omar Khan: agree. we'll announce winners on booth mic.
Nina Zhao: order placed with BadgeCraft (PO# 4521). vendor ETA Jun 25. tracking to follow.
Leah Park: thanks team. flag any blockers by EOD Thu. otherwise we'll lock copy + shipping. :rocket:
